  "explanation": "Finiteness of the minimal elements (the write-up's route to L6.2) rests on Step 4 applied to the concrete family, with hypothesis (iii) supplied by Claim 3.2. Claim 3.2's proof takes a minimal transversal T and forms the integer \u03c0(T) = \u220f_{p\u2208T} p, which exists only for finite T; nothing in Steps 1\u20133 shows minimal transversals of C are finite. Yet the theorem's final step applies (iii) to a minimal transversal contained in the infinite set I \u222a Z_\u03c9, exactly the case Claim 3.2 does not cover (Case A, where finiteness is automatic, is explicitly ruled out). So hypothesis (iii) is unverified in the strength used, and the finiteness conclusion is not established as written; closing it needs a new lemma bounding minimal transversals.",
